about: P5 startup manifest: the instruction bearing files codex-cli 0.160.0 writes into an empty CODEX_HOME at startup, by canonical relative path (relative to CODEX_HOME, forward slashes), sha256 of the exact bytes, file type, origin and permitted role. isolation.startup_instruction_files accepts a runtime file only when its path AND sha256 are listed here. Entries under mutable_runtime_artifacts are not instruction bearing and are never accepted by this list; they are inventoried and removed after every call (Isolation.finish).

findings: features list (the frozen route arguments and disable list) writes nothing into CODEX_HOME (Fable F4 reproduced); it cannot produce the startup inventory
--version and login status write only the PATH helper aliases tmp/arg0/codex-arg0<random>/{.lock, apply_patch.bat, applypatch.bat}

debug prompt-input (renders the model-visible prompt input, makes no model request) runs the startup install: it writes the 49 files under skills/.system listed in files, plus installation_id and .sandbox_migration

the 49 skills/.system files are byte identical (path and sha256) to those the build time no auth exec probe wrote into scratchpad rep/cliprobe/home (Fable F5), so an exec of 0.160.0 writes the same bundled skill set
limits: D4: the exec probe home predates the final argv (--enable skip_host_skill_discovery, route security arguments). Whether the final exec argv writes exactly this set is first observed by the telemetry probe; under the operative rule (Astra, D4) an inventory outside this manifest stops the run, the annex is approved again and the freeze is redone
capture.method: local non-model commands of the pinned binary in fresh empty CODEX_HOME copies built by the harness isolation code (Isolation.empty_home at a worker path under ~/.ozmap_rep, isolation.child_env, run.run_local); no auth.json was placed in the home and nothing was copied from ~/.codex, so no authenticated request was possible
